title: Super Melon
description: 2 melon slices can be combined into 1 super melons. They fill up 4 saturation slots [appleskin] and 4 full food slots.
body:
Four normal melon slices can be combined into two super melons. They fill up four saturation slots [appleskin] and four full food slots. 
Made because I had alot of melons but they arn't a very good food sourse, so I made this!
